'''Bren-Nevin Rordan''' was a [[New Republic Intelligence Service]] agent. A native of [[Kirima (Kalinda system)|Kirima]], he joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] after the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of Alderaan]], trained as an intelligence agent then returned to Kirima. His cover was as a successful galactic [[art dealer]] who ran [[Rordan's Galactic Exotic Art]].
